Sant Genís dels Agudells — Barcelona, Spain

🟡 Local press research

In detail

A 53-year-old local resident was fatally stabbed on 20 April 2026 at a local square while trying to break up a fight between other men at a neighbourhood gathering. Separately, in 2019 an illegally squatted former school building was linked by shopkeepers to systematic shoplifting and intimidation. The April 2026 homicide involved people known to each other rather than a stranger/traveler-targeted attack, but is a serious and very recent violent incident that raises night-time caution. Sources checked: en.ara.cat, Apr 2026; elcaso.elnacional.cat, Apr 2026; Metròpoli Obert, 21 May 2019.
